FAIL_TO_PASS: supports generateBundle hook including reporting rendered exports and source length
sourcemap-true-generatebundle: emits sourcemaps before generateBundle hook
inline-dynamic-imports-bundle: ignores non-bundled modules when inlining dynamic imports
original-file-name: forwards the original file name to other hooks
asset-originalfilename-in-bundle: marks the "originalFileName" property of emitted assets as deprecated in generateBundle
validate: use CLI --validate to test whether output is well formed
transform-without-code: allows using the transform hook for annotations only without returning a code property and breaking sourcemaps
sourcemap-inline-generatebundle: includes inline sourcemap comments in generateBundle hook
asset-render-chunk-originalfilename-in-bundle: marks the "originalFileName" property of emitted assets as deprecated in generateBundle when emitted during generate phase
file-references-in-bundle: lists referenced files in the bundle
bundle-facade-order: respects the order of entry points when there are additional facades for chunks
asset-render-chunk-name-in-bundle: marks the "name" property of emitted assets as deprecated in generateBundle when emitted during generate phase
asset-name-in-bundle: marks the "name" property of emitted assets as deprecated in generateBundle
original-file-names: forwards the original file name to other hooks
